content.short: With BetttingAda we can have public and verifiable sports bet. Odds are simply calculated with the amounts the users bet and distributed to winners.
content.description: The project will solve the closed source and opaque business model from bet promotors. All Ada betted on a game is distributed to winners All betting contracts are open source. Contracts Audited by third party. Bet with Ada get Ada back. All Ada used in a bet is distributed to winners (minor minimum lovelaces due to rounding values) Values on each bet can be traced in Cardano Blockchain, Contract Addresses. Odds are not manipulated; they reflect gamers bets. Verifiable on chain. Security of being Cardano Smart Contract.
